overview.text: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD) is procuring subscription services for Red Hat JBoss Enterprise Application Platform (JBOSS EAP) and Extended Life Support (ELS) for a one-year term. The tender involves supply, implementation, and enabling support services to upgrade from the unsupported JBoss 5 version.

issuing_organization: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)

scope.text: Supply of Red Hat JBoss EAP support subscription and Extended Life Support (ELS) subscription.
Services include supply, implementation, commissioning, maintenance, upgrades, updates, patches, and technical assistance within 48 hours of purchase order issuance.
Deliverables include valid support subscriptions, access credentials, documentation, and compliance/audit records.
Services are restricted to OEM Licensed products; modified software is excluded. Advisory services may be provided on a time and materials basis.

key_requirements.text: Bidders must submit an Earnest Money Deposit (EMD) of ₹2,76,000/- or a Bank Guarantee; Micro and Small Enterprises are exempt with valid Udyam Certificate.
Successful bidders must submit KYC forms, sign the Service Level Agreement (SLA), Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA), and Pre-Contract Integrity Pact on ₹500 stamp paper.
Bidders must provide audited financial statements for the last three fiscal years and proof of no debarment/blacklisting since 01.04.2021.
The Service Provider must furnish a Performance Bank Guarantee (PGB) for 3% of the total order value and retain records for 7 years post-termination.

eligibility.text: Bidders must be duly organized entities capable of providing timely support and enabling OEM services for Red Hat products.
Disqualification applies for violations of the Integrity Pact, incorrect statements regarding transgressions, or adverse litigations.
The Service Provider must comply with the Contract Labour Act and ensure subcontracted personnel undergo background checks.

important_dates.text: Last date for submission of pre-Bid queries: 24th September 2025, 05:00 PM.
Date of Pre-Bid Meeting: 25th September 2025, 3:00 PM.
Last date for submission of Bid: 1st October 2025, 3:00 PM.
Bids must remain valid for 180 days from the last date of opening of Commercial Bids.

commercial_requirements.text: Prices quoted must be firm and valid for the entire one-year contract period with no escalation allowed.
All support subscriptions must be supplied within 48 hours of the issue of the purchase order.
Payment terms involve 100% release upon supply, implementation, and acceptance; invoices paid within 30 days subject to SLA deductions.

project_duration.text: The subscription services are valid for one year from the date of activation unless otherwise specified in the purchase order.
The Integrity Pact expires for the Contractor 12 months after the last payment and for other Bidders 6 months after award.

important_conditions.text: Confidential Information must be returned or destroyed upon termination; oral information must be confirmed in writing within fifteen days.
Termination may occur for unjustifiable delays, failure to upgrade critical software, or non-attendance of after-sales calls (3+ occasions).
Disputes are resolved amicably within 30 days, followed by sole arbitration in Mumbai under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
The Service Provider must provide a Reverse Transition Mechanism for 3 months post-notice period, including data transfer in readable format.
